acceptanceCriteria: A user-prompt task longer than MaxQueryCharacters produces ranked context from a deterministic bounded query with a named degradation (or, if refusal is kept by spec decision, the refusal names the limit and the observed length), with tests.
The harness spec records the chosen behaviour and keeps oracle parity.
body: Found during Beamfall setup (beamfall/core-history#43, 2026-10-20). core-history's context-packet.sh passes the ticket body as the harness user-prompt task; for long tickets `corvint harness event` returns `invalid-harness-input: task exceeds the bounded query contract` (internal/gokernel/harness.go:256, MaxQueryCharacters=2000 / MaxTaskBytes=16384), so the packet falls back to rank_failed with no ranked context. Expected: an over-long prompt is bounded deterministically (e.g. leading MaxQueryCharacters runes, with a recorded truncation degradation) or the refusal names the limit and observed length so adapters can bound it themselves. Actual: hard refusal with no length detail; real prompts and ticket bodies routinely exceed 2,000 characters. Version: corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676.

title: harness event user-prompt refuses tasks over 2,000 characters instead of truncating or bounding the query, so long ticket text gets no ranked context
